Mattermost.note: Brand name; never translate. Compounds take a hyphen: 'Mattermost-serveren', 'Mattermost-fællesskabet'.

Enterprise Edition.note: Product edition name; keep in English. The existing catalog once renders it 'Virksomhedsudgave' (about.teamEditiont1) — do not follow that.

Team Edition.note: Keep in English. Existing 'Team Udgave' (about.teamEditiont0) is a legacy rendering — do not follow it.

Mattermost Cloud.note: Keep in English. Do not render 'Cloud' as 'Sky' (one legacy string does).

Channels.note: Product name; keep in English. The common noun 'channels' is 'kanaler'.

Calls.note: Product name; keep in English. The common noun 'call' is 'opkald'.

LDAP.note: 'AD/LDAP' stays as-is; compounds take a hyphen: 'AD/LDAP-brugernavn'.

MFA.note: Spelled-out form in existing strings is 'multifaktorgodkendelse'.

System Console.note: Common gender: systemkonsollen (definite). Established rendering (24 occurrences); never leave 'System Console' in English.

marketplace.note: Existing catalog keeps the English name 'Marketplace' (11 vs 1 'Markedsplads'); treat as a proper name for the plugin store.

channel.note: Common gender: kanalen, plural kanaler. Compounds are solid: kanalmedlemmer, kanalindstillinger.

team.note: Neuter: teamet, plural teams. Avoid 'hold'/'gruppe' which appear sporadically in legacy strings. Compounds: teamnavn, teammedlemmer.

post.note: Same as message. 'opslag' appears in a few legacy strings — prefer 'besked'.

message.note: Common gender: beskeden, plural beskeder. Not 'meddelelse' (which the catalog reserves mainly for system notices/alerts).

thread.note: Common gender: tråden, plural tråde. The Threads view is 'Tråde'.

reply.note: Noun: svar (neuter, plural svar). Verb: svare / button 'Svar'.

direct message.note: Plural 'direkte beskeder'. Keep the DM abbreviation as-is.

mention.note: Noun: omtale (common gender, plural omtaler). Verb: omtale / 'at nævne'. '@mention' → '@omtale'.

notification.note: Common gender, plural notifikationer. Majority rendering (143); 'meddelelse' is used only loosely in older strings. Compounds: e-mailnotifikationer, skrivebordsnotifikationer.

pin.note: Button 'Fastgør til kanal'; pinned messages = 'Fastgjorte beskeder'; unpin = 'Frigør'.

bookmark.note: Neuter: bogmærket, plural bogmærker. Verb: 'Tilføj et bogmærke'. Bookmarks bar = 'Bogmærkelinje'.

draft.note: Common gender: kladden, plural kladder. Drafts view = 'Kladder'.

scheduled post.note: Plural 'planlagte beskeder'. Existing strings also use 'planlagte kladder' in the drafts view.

emoji.note: Common gender: emojien. Catalog uses the same form for plural ('brugerdefinerede emoji'); 'emojis' is also acceptable.

custom emoji.note: Plural 'brugerdefinerede emoji'. Do not leave 'Custom Emoji' in English (one legacy admin string does).

status.note: Common gender: statussen. Use 'status' for availability.

do not disturb.note: Catalog is split between 'Forstyr ikke' (5) and 'Vil ikke forstyrres' (4, in modal.manual_status). Prefer 'Forstyr ikke'. Keep the DND abbreviation as-is.

away.note: Established status label (userAccountMenu, mobile). Lowercase 'væk' in sentences.

guest.note: Common gender: gæsten, plural gæster. Guest access = gæsteadgang.

member.note: Neuter: medlemmet, plural medlemmer. Compounds: kanalmedlemmer, teammedlemmer.

system admin.note: Plural 'systemadministratorer'. Use the same for 'System Administrator'.

sign in.note: Button 'Log ind'; noun 'login'. Translate 'sign in' and 'log in' identically.

sign out.note: Button 'Log ud'. Translate 'sign out' and 'log out' identically.

join.note: Button 'Deltag'. Catalog also uses 'tilmelde sig kanalen' and 'tilslutte sig'; prefer 'deltage i' / 'Deltag i kanal'. 'joined the channel' = 'deltog i kanalen'.

unarchive.note: Button 'Gendan kanal' (channel_header.unarchive). Avoid 'Gendan arkiv' / 'GENÅBNING' seen in legacy modal strings.

mute.note: Button 'Slå kanal til lydløs'; muted = 'lydløs'; unmute = 'Slå lydløs fra'. Same verb for microphone in Calls.

unfollow.note: Button 'Stop med at følge tråd' (established). 'unfollowed' = 'Holdt op med at følge'.

favorite.note: Common gender: favoritten, plural favoritter; sidebar category 'Favoritter'. Verb: 'Tilføj til favoritter'; unfavorite: 'Fjern fra favoritter'.

slash command.note: Hyphenated compound (30 occurrences); not 'slash kommando' (4 legacy).

webhook.note: Kept in English; common gender ('webhooken', plural 'webhooks'). Compounds take a hyphen: webhook-data.

trigger word.note: Catalog mixes 'trigger-ord', 'trigger ord' and 'udløsende ord'; prefer the hyphenated 'trigger-ord'. Plural 'trigger-ord'.

plugin.note: Kept in English; neuter ('pluginet', plural 'plugins'). Not 'udvidelse'.

bot.note: Common gender: botten, plural bots. Bot account = botkonto.

scheme.note: Neuter: skemaet, plural skemaer. Permission scheme = 'tilladelsesskema'.

sidebar.note: Catalog is split between 'sidebjælke' (12) and 'sidepanel' (11); prefer 'sidebjælke' for the left channel sidebar. The right-hand panel ('RHS') may be 'højre sidepanel'.

attachment.note: Common gender, plural vedhæftninger. 'vedhæftet fil' is fine in prose.

system message.note: Catalog mixes 'systembesked' and 'systemmeddelelse'; prefer 'systembesked' for consistency with 'besked'.

urgent.note: Priority label (post_priority.priority.urgent). In prose 'akut'/'hastende' also acceptable; 'Important' = 'Vigtig'. Do not leave 'Urgent' in English (one legacy admin string does).

recap.note: Webapp recaps UI uses 'referat' (neuter, plural 'referater') for the entity; 'opsummering' is used for the summarizing action and in some modal strings. Prefer 'referat' for the noun.

agent.note: AI assistant. Common gender: agenten, plural agenter. 'AI agent' = 'AI-agent'. The product name 'Agents' stays English.

burn-on-read.note: Existing admin strings keep English 'Burn-on-Read' (compounded: 'Burn-on-Read-beskeder'); do not translate literally.

magic link.note: Majority rendering (3 vs 1 English 'Magic Link'). Neuter: 'et magisk link', 'linket'.

announcement banner.note: Catalog has 'annonceringsbanner' and one typo 'meddelelsesbannerr'; prefer 'annonceringsbanner'. Bare 'banner' = banner.

collapsed reply threads.note: Established feature name in user.settings.display and admin.experimental. Do not render literally ('sammenklappede svartråde').

auto-translation.note: 'auto-translated' = 'auto-oversat' (channel_header.autotranslationMessage); hyphenated 'auto-oversættelse' also exists in short labels.

access control.note: Attribute-based access control = 'attributbaseret adgangskontrol' (admin UI also uses 'adgangsstyring' in a few strings); policy = politik.

attribute.note: Common gender: attributten, plural attributter. Custom profile attribute = 'brugerdefineret profilattribut'.

Town Square.note: Established default-channel name in server i18n (api.channel.create_default_channels.town_square). One legacy webapp string has 'by-pladsen' — do not follow.

Off-Topic.note: Established default-channel name in server i18n (api.channel.create_default_channels.off_topic).
